Name: Sea Bags Recycled Sail Chebeague Messenger Bag
Natural: Quiet, unspoiled Chebeague is a highlight for anyone cruising Maine's coast. Inspired by our island neighbor, the Chebeague collection is handsome and rugged. Designed in recycled Dacron sail cloth and navy cotton canvas, our Messenger Bag is ideal for everyday use and great for travel. It features a padded compartment that accommodates a 15" laptop, a large exterior pocket and small zippered interior hanging pocket. Removable webbed cotton shoulder strap. Magnetic closure. Spot clean only. Handmade in Portland, Maine, USA. One Size: 16"W x 13"H x 2.75"D
